Asal sale = bill − return (void bill nah: Net sale = bills − returns (void bills are not counted). Service charges on bills (delivery, fitting) also add to sales — shown separately below the item list. Cost = cost when the bill was made; if no cost was entered, today's cost. Expenses only once paid (not pending). Net profit = profit − expenses − damaged, lost or short-counted stock. A return counts on the day of the bill it came from. Reports, Profit report, P&L and Dashboard all use these same numbers.
Asal sale = list rate − discount − retur: Net sale = list rate − discount − returns. Profit = net sale − cost of goods. Cost is what the item cost when the bill was made.
